name: totp
description: Universal Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) and HMAC-based One-Time Password (HOTP) token generator and validator using standard Web Crypto APIs.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when verifying 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) codes from authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) or generating temporal authorization passcodes.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration: window size, digit length, time step duration (default 30s).
